description: Deletes a flow as Delete on the Automations page does. A flow that has never run on a conversation is removed for good. A flow that has already run on conversations is instead switched off and kept (its runs in progress end), because its history points at it; Archive (set_flow_archived) hides a flow without deleting it. A system flow cannot be deleted. flow_id comes from read('flows'); check the flow's steps before deleting, so a flow with something the company still needs is archived instead. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_flow
title: Delete a flow
